Easy Veggie Stir Fry 🥦🥕

Ingredients:
- 2 cups broccoli florets
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 cup snap peas
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 3 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
- Cooked rice for serving

Steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in wok or large pan over high heat
2. Add garlic and ginger, stir fry 30 seconds
3. Add carrots, cook 2 minutes
4. Add broccoli and bell pepper, cook 3 minutes
5. Add snap peas, cook 2 more minutes
6. Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil
7. Toss everything together for 1 minute
8. Serve over rice!
